column1: # Test queries for the search engine, with hand-made relevance judgments.
# Columns: id, query, what the query tests, relevant texts (file:grade).
# Grade 2 = the article is about the query; grade 1 = the article answers part of it.
# Judged by reading the texts in corpus_clean/ (one annotator). Texts not listed are judged not relevant.
# Kinds: plain = ordinary keyword query; inflection = query form differs from the text form;
# compound = the query word is part of a compound in the text; spelling = umlaut-less, lower-case or typo;
# entity = a name that the texts write in another form.
